messages:
emma_sales: Quick heads-up — AcmeCorp POC hitting 5xx from eu-west prod endpoint when ramping test traffic, demo at 10:00 PT tomorrow. Getting ~20% 5xx and latency spikes to 1.5s.

linda_engineer: Sorry — are those 5xx 503 or 500? any request ids from client logs?

emma_sales: Mostly 503s. Client sends request-id in x-request-id header, sample ids: a1b2c3, d4e5f6. Also see rate-limit header X-Rate-Remaining: 0 in some responses.

kai_oncall: @linda_engineer I'm looking. Can you paste the last 5xx log line from the gateway? Also which model variant? eu-west is routing to rdx-gpt-xl-16q.

linda_engineer: grabbing logs now — gimme 30s

deploy-bot: Canary deploy rdx-gpt-xl-16q -> eu-west completed at 2026-03-20T22:05:12Z

linda_engineer: logs: ```
[2026-03-20T22:18:03Z] request_id=a1b2c3 -> POST /v1/generate 503 backend-overloaded queue_len=120 instance=swarm-12
[2026-03-20T22:18:03Z] service=router fallback=none reason=rate_shed token_bucket=exhausted
```

raj_support: Queue_len 120 — looks like autoscaler didn't spin up fast enough. Any recent config changes for burstpool or scale windows?

linda_engineer: We merged a routing change yesterday to prefer eu-west primary for AcmeCorp due to data locality; also reduced burstpool headroom to 10% to cut costs.

kai_oncall: That explains it — traffic spike from demo simulation pushed eu-west over threshold and without burstpool we hit rate-shed. Short-term: can we flip routing to global-failover to us-west to spread load?

linda_engineer: I can change routing within 2 min. But note customer requires eu region for data residency for some requests.

emma_sales: Customer allows eu for most but demo traffic is synthetic and okay to route to us-west for demo only. Please proceed.

linda_engineer: switching routing policy to prefer-us-west-fallback now... done. Confirming traffic draining.

deploy-bot: Routing policy update applied: acme-prod -> prefer-us-west-fallback at 2026-03-20T22:21:42Z

kai_oncall: After switching, 5xx dropped to ~1%. But we're seeing increased p95 latency in us-west, autoscaler is behind by ~30s — recommend temporary manual scale-up and increase burstpool headroom to 25%.

linda_engineer: manual scale-up initiated: +4 instances in us-west. Also bumped burstpool headroom to 25% for acme-prod.

emma_sales: Thanks — any impact on pricing for demo? Customer asked if we'll charge extra for burstpool usage during demo.

linda_engineer: For POC we've agreed to absorb small burstpool costs; if sustained we'll bill based on reserved capacity + overage per contract.

raj_support: Follow-ups: 1) SRE to add a safeguard to prevent burstpool headroom dropping below 15% for production-facing customers 2) Eng to add faster cold-start mitigation (prefetch weights) 3) Sales to note that routing changes may be needed for EU residency demos

sre-shiftlead: Filing incident ticket INC-2026-0421 with notes and attaching logs. Will run postmortem tomorrow.

emma_sales: Great, please ping me when postmortem is ready — I need a blameless summary for the customer and the security questionnaire about fallback behavior.

linda_engineer: noted — will include timeline, root cause (routing+low burstpool), mitigations, and cost impact. ETA 24h.

kai_oncall: Monitor is green. closing thread unless something else shows up :thumbsup:

emma_sales: :raised_hands: Thanks everyone — saved the demo.
